result_revision.change_summary: Initial dummy/candidate AirfRANS Full-split submission for transolverpp-full.

methodology.record_note: Adapted from the official Transolver++ reference implementation (https://github.com/thuml/Transolver_plus/blob/main/models/Transolver_plus.py). Submitter-reported DDP adaptation note: the original implementation uses sequence parallelism (dist_nn.all_reduce inside Physics_Attention_1D_Eidetic) to synchronize attention tokens across devices, assuming one large spatial graph partitioned across GPUs. This pipeline instead uses standard Distributed Data Parallelism: because AirfRANS meshes have highly variable node counts (preventing batch stacking), each GPU processes exactly one intact mesh per step, so the entire graph for a sample fits in one GPU's VRAM. Leaving the cross-GPU all_reduce active under this DDP setup would aggregate attention tokens across independent meshes on different GPUs, cross-contaminating physical/geometric features between unrelated samples. The submitter therefore bypassed the dist_nn.all_reduce synchronization in the forward pass; global synchronization is instead handled correctly and exclusively by the DDP backend during the backward pass (gradient reduction), preserving strict per-sample independence in the forward computation. find_unused_parameters=True was set in the DDP wrapper to handle the idle condition-embedding layer present in the original architecture without structural deletions.

architecture.description: Transolver++ (Physics_Attention_1D_Eidetic variant with Gumbel-softmax adaptive-temperature slice weighting): an input MLP embeds 8 per-node channels (6 broadcast global case parameters + 2D native coordinates) into a 256-wide hidden representation, followed by 5 Transolver++ blocks (LayerNorm -> physics attention with 8 heads / 32 slices -> LayerNorm -> MLP, residual throughout), with a final linear head on the last block producing all 3 output channels (Ux, Uy, p) in one forward pass. A per-case scalar 'condition' embedding exists in the architecture but is never populated (always None) in this deployment, so it is architecturally present but functionally inactive; it was kept only to satisfy DistributedDataParallel's find_unused_parameters requirement.

components.role: Embeds the 8 input channels (6 broadcast global params + 2 coordinates) into the 256-wide hidden representation.
components.description: Single-layer preprocessing MLP (8 -> 512 -> 256, GELU), no residual layers.

components.role: 5-layer adaptive-slicing physics-attention core; the final block's linear head produces the 3 output channels (Ux, Uy, p).
components.description: 5 stacked Transolver_plus_block modules (LayerNorm, 8-head/32-slice Gumbel-softmax adaptive physics attention, LayerNorm, MLP, residual connections throughout); the last block additionally applies a LayerNorm + Linear(256, 3) output head.

components.role: Dead/inactive layer: a Linear(3, 256) condition embedding and a small learnable placeholder bias, present in the architecture but never exercised because the model is always called with condition=None in this deployment.
components.description: Kept only so DistributedDataParallel's find_unused_parameters handling does not require structurally deleting this head from the reference implementation.

input_features.name: global_case_parameters
input_features.description: Inlet velocity, angle of attack, and 4 NACA shape parameters, standardized and broadcast to every native mesh point.

predicted_fields.description: Cartesian velocity (Ux, Uy) on every native 2D flow-domain point.
Kinematic pressure on every native 2D flow-domain point.

Airfoil-curve pressure, selected from the domain pressure prediction at the native surface points and reorganized onto the airfoil's native point order (methodology-contract.json explicitly allows this: 'may be derived by selecting the corresponding output').

data_handling.normalization: Fixed (not per-run-fitted) mean/std standardization hardcoded in the training script: global params mean=[62.078843, 4.505005, 2.662092, 4.36979, -0.177399, 12.383638] std=[17.895404, 5.439110, 1.780338, 2.223083, 0.847565, 4.266170]; coordinates mean=[0.496883, 0.009349] std=[0.680004, 0.314274]; targets (u, v, p) mean=[42.325618, 9.802131, -455.852231] std=[29.694971, 31.015622, 2959.004581]. Predictions are denormalized (pred * std + mean) before packing onto native points.
data_handling.preprocessing: Each case's complete native internal-mesh point cloud and (u, v, p) fields are read directly from a pre-processed AirfRANS pickle (X_original, fields); no remeshing, cropping, or geometric preprocessing.
data_handling.sampling: None: the complete native point set for every case is used for both training supervision and inference. Batch size is fixed at exactly 1 full mesh per GPU step (no subsampling), because AirfRANS meshes have highly variable node counts that prevent standard batch stacking.

stages.description: Single from-scratch training run on the official AirfRANS Full-split training partition (800 cases), validated each epoch against the official 200-case Full-split test partition.

loss.description: Mean squared error between predicted and normalized ground-truth (Ux, Uy, p), averaged over all native points in the mesh.
loss.weighting: Uniform per-point MSE; no field-wise or spatial weighting.

optimizers.name: AdamW
optimizers.schedule: Constant learning rate, no scheduler. AdamW weight_decay=1e-4.

compute.measurement_notes: From the training log ('Training complete in 13h 48m 22.05s'), 2-way DistributedDataParallel, ~124.2s/epoch across 400 epochs.

checkpoints.bytes_description: Raw PyTorch state_dict (torch.save(model.module.state_dict(), 'transolver_3ch_final.pt')) saved unconditionally at the end of the fixed 400-epoch schedule.
checkpoints.role: Single checkpoint; one forward pass produces all three predicted fields (Ux, Uy, p).
checkpoints.selection_rule: Final checkpoint after completing a fixed, predetermined 400-epoch schedule; NOT selected using validation or evaluation-set performance. A separate 'transolver_3ch_best.pt' checkpoint (selected by minimizing validation loss on split_key='full_test', which was verified to be byte-for-byte identical to this benchmark's official 200-case Full evaluation split) was deliberately NOT used for this submission, since its selection used the evaluation cases.

inference_compute.measurement_notes: Single uninterrupted campaign covering data loading, normalization, GPU transfer and the forward pass for all 200 Full-split cases (batch size 1, sequential, single GPU). Does not include the separate scipy cKDTree exact-match/IDW(k=5) repacking step onto native mesh points (pack_predictions.py), which was not separately timed.

evaluation.command: python3 -m reference.evaluate_predictions --support-manifest /mnt/Data_A/AirfRANS_Inference_Handover_2026-09-09/FluidsBench/airfrans-scoring-support/airfrans-native-ground-truth-v1-candidate/manifest.json --case-set standard --prediction-manifest <layer2-output>/manifest.json --submission-id transolverpp-full-v1 --split-id full --output metrics/cases.json ; python3 scripts/finalize_airfrans_metrics.py (folds in velocity_profile_r2 + composite scores)

note: Candidate AirfRANS schema-v3 package.
